title: DAO Schnorr vectors are regenerated by the crypto implementation under test
description: test/vectors/generate_dao_origin_signature.py imports derive_keypair/sign from python/src/lichen/crypto/schnorr48.py to generate the canonical DAO signatures. Its JSON provenance mentions a separate C cross-check command, but no repository test/CI invocation enforces that cross-check, and --check only compares output regenerated by the same production signer. A defect or domain/transcript regression in the Python signer can therefore be blessed into the language-neutral security vectors. Generate with test/vectors/reference_schnorr48.py (or another mandatory independent oracle), retain fixed known-answer assertions, and make CI verify the independent result before accepting regeneration.
